steps.name: ภาพรวม: ดูข้าวหลามตัดของบอส

สีม่วง = 4 คนที่ไกลที่สุด

Take them in turns; nobody takes two in a row

pink = the 4 nearest
purple = the 4 farthest

Start: tanks/healers inside the boss's target circle / DPS outside
Spots: MT ST in front of the boss / H1 H2 beside it / D3 D4 behind, to the sides / D1 D2 behind

game8 splits it into 2 cases: the 1st and 2nd tells differ, or they are the same (next steps)

Purple diamonds, apart = the 4 farthest from the boss take the cones

ทำเหมือนครั้งแรก (ดู Roseblood Bloom ต้นช่วงกลาง): หลบ cone ที่หมุน แล้ว spread บนช่องที่ไม่มีวงเวท

en.name: 2nd time: as the first
en.note:
By game8's timeline: Roseblood Bloom comes again, with Alexandrian Thunder II and Alexandrian Thunder III
Do it as the first time (see Roseblood Bloom at the start of the middle part): dodge the turning cones, then spread on tiles without circles

Then Thorned Catharsis (raid-wide) and Specter of the Lost (tankbuster on tethers)

ใช้ mitigate ให้ครบทุก stack และตีบอสให้ตายก่อนร่ายจบ

en.mech: Stock Break + Roseblood Withering + Rose Red
en.name: Three stacks, then time is up (enrage)
en.note:
By game8's timeline: Stock Break 3 times in a row (the multi-hit stack, see the first part)
then Roseblood Withering and Rose Red, the time-up cast (enrage)
Mitigate every stack and kill the boss before it finishes
